verdict.rationale: Shortwave documents custom AI filters that automatically label, star and archive mail using plain-English scripts the user writes, which covers both auto-labeling and steering. It also documents one-click identification of important emails and todos, and triggers that organize threads into todos, which covers surfacing what needs attention. All of this is vendor-claimed only; missing for 10: any evidence of auditing AI triage decisions (logs or explanations of why a filter acted), and independent or hands-on corroboration of AI filter accuracy.
